paragraphs: R. Chanina. R. Chanina said, “I asked R. Eliezer several questions in the great assembly house”—the great study house: Bekhorot 5b. It appears there that this R. Eliezer is R. Eliezer the Great, R. Yehoshua's colleague. If so, I do not know who this R. Chanina is. Perhaps he is R. Chanina bar Chama's grandfather.
